machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd65-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists: reference **RD-1015**, customer Marlow Bakery, created 2026-09-16, initially status Draft, detail page at `/#/tickets/t15`.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd65-n1 RD Part A` created with cost 100, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier Northwind Supplies. App-computed price: **$125.00** (row: $100.00 / 25% / 1 / Northwind Supplies / $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd65-n1 RD Part B` created with cost 200, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier Northwind Supplies. App-computed price: **$250.00**. Table total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Table total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status is **Ready** (badge verified live and after page reload). The precondition the app enforces: **a ticket must have at least one part before it can be marked Ready**. Exact refusal text (alert with `data-testid="error-message"` / `error-unmet`): title **"Ticket is not ready"** with the unmet item **"A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"**. Because RD-1015 already had two parts, `Mark Ready` succeeded immediately with nothing extra required — I surfaced the exact precondition text by creating a scratch probe ticket (RD-1016) with zero parts, attempting Mark Ready on it, and reading the error; that probe was then archived. After marking Ready, the controls changed to `Mark Draft` / `Mark Closed`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted via each row's Delete action, confirming the in-page dialog ("Delete the part \"…\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." → Delete part). Parts table refreshed to the empty state **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with no data rows and no total row. The ticket was then archived via `Archive ticket` (applied immediately, no dialog): Status row now shows **Ready** plus an **Archived** badge (`data-testid="ticket-archived"`), and the button relabelled to "Unarchive ticket". Final list check confirms RD-1015 shows Status Ready, Parts 0, Archived badge — and no ticket created by this run remains active (the probe ticket RD-1016 is also archived).
